title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Service Rules: Light-Out Reports and Repairs
content:
**Area and Security Lighting Rental — light-out reports and repairs.** A light-out may be reported through any of the product's reporting channels, and reporting is free. A confirmed report opens a repair order, and the light is repaired within the repair standard of 5 business days, during business hours only, since light repairs are not made outside business hours. A further report on a light already out of service is recorded but opens no second repair order.

## Reporting

- **Channels.** A light-out may be reported to a live member services representative by phone, on the automated phone line, in the SmartHub app or on the cooperative's website. A report through any one of them is as good as through another.
- **What may be reported.** A member may report a light that is out, cycling, burning by day, damaged, or on a leaning pole. Each report is recorded with the date reported, the channel used and what was reported.
- **No charge.** Reporting is free through every channel.

## From report to repair

| Stage | What the records show |
|---|---|
| Report received | The report is recorded on the light |
| Report confirmed | A repair order is opened; the light is out of service as of the date of the confirmed report |
| Repair completed | The light is active again, with the repair date recorded and the out-of-service date cleared |

The repair standard counts 5 business days from the confirmed report, and the work is done during business hours.

## A second report on the same light

| Light's status when the report arrives | Recorded? | Opens a repair order? |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Yes | Yes, once the report is confirmed |
| Out of service | Yes | No, a repair order is already open |

## Questions answered

**Does a member pay anything to report a light that is out?**
No. Reporting is free.

**The light was reported and confirmed yesterday, so it is already out of service, and the member calls today about it. Is a new repair order opened?**
No. The member's report is recorded, but a light already out of service does not get a second repair order.

**Will a crew come out at night to fix a yard light?**
No. Light repairs are made during business hours only.
